replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
In the future, please try to get a video of this kind of offence. For chat-related offences screenshots are fine, but for rules such as Spawnkill, hacking, etc., videos are needed.

Thanks for the report, but these players will not be dealt with.
